principles: The profile is a prior, not ground truth: a row spacing, a stage or a cover the imagery measures reliably outranks what the profile expects, and a disagreement is reported rather than corrected toward the profile.
A position inferred from the planting pattern is an expected plant, never a verified one.
Green off the row is a weed candidate, not a weed: corn that leans, a double, a volunteer or an interseeded cover crop is also green off the row.
No species name from the pixels at 1 cm or coarser; species lists are regional and seasonal priors.
Without a known pixel size no metric claim is made; with a pixel size coarser than the analysis needs, the analysis is disabled with its reason instead of producing a weaker answer.
A stage from the planting date is an estimate with its error stated; the profile never reports a single stage from the calendar.

policies.when: No crop on file, or a crop with no profile.
policies.message: No crop profile for this field: the analysis uses crop-neutral defaults.

policies.when: The corn profile's status is experimental.
policies.message: Corn profile is experimental: its row, cover and position rules are benchmarked on rendered stands, three photos and one public field, not yet on your fields.

policies.when: The imagery has no pixel size (no georeference, no EXIF altitude, none given).
policies.message: The pixel size is not known, so no spacing, size or area is stated.

policies.when: The pixel size is coarser than the capability's maxGsdCm in the algorithm file.
policies.message: The imagery is too coarse for this in corn; the limit and the reason are named per analysis.
No planting date: closure, the critical period and the expected cover are not checked.

policies.when: A stage range was estimated from the planting date.
policies.message: Stage estimated from the planting date (calendar), often off by one to three leaves; not observed.

policies.when: The whole estimated stage range lies past V9 (30 in rows close about V10).
policies.message: The canopy has closed or is closing at this stage: weed cover between the rows can no longer be measured from above.

policies.when: The vegetation share of the photo or the cells is 0.85 or more.
policies.message: Almost all of the ground is under green: between-row cover and weed counts are not measured.

policies.when: The measured pitch is more than 8% from every planted corn spacing.
policies.message: The rows read at a spacing corn is not planted at: the reading is kept; check the crop on file or the read.

policies.when: Row coherence under 0.30, or rows from brightness only.
policies.message: The rows are uncertain (heavy weeds, closed canopy, curved rows): position-based weed calls are weaker here.
No rows found: nothing is called a weed by position.

policies.when: Measured green cover is more than 15 points outside the crop's expected range at every stage in the estimated range.
policies.message: The green cover does not fit corn at this stage: the planting date, the stage or heavy weed pressure is off.

policies.when: The automatic vegetation split fell below the index of grey (0).
policies.message: The automatic green split was separating soil from residue; the corn ExGR gate kept the mask to green plants.

policies.when: Always, for corn at 1 cm or coarser.
policies.message: Weeds inside the crop row are not judged: they cannot be told from corn at this resolution.

policies.when: Always, for corn at 1 cm or coarser.
policies.message: Species are not identified from the imagery; the list is what is commonly reported in corn here at this time of year.

policies.when: The pressure scheme's basis is provisional.
policies.message: Corn pressure classes are provisional: US guidance acts on weed height (before about 10 cm) and stage, not on cover.
Not supported for corn yet; the reason is named.

gaps: No calibration of how often an uncertainty code is right: the codes are rules from the research, not measured detectors (except the resolution and canopy gates, which are arithmetic).
The coherence level for ROWS_UNCERTAIN (0.30) is reasoned from the coherence of rows of known width, not measured against row truth.
